Maya Patel: Quick sync — AuroraTech wants to sign this week. Procurement needs final committed pricing, SOC2 attestation, KMS addendum signed, and peering IPs. Can we triage?

Diego Ramos: I'll take peering. Need their AWS account IDs + CIDR. If we get them today, peering ~48h. PrivateLink adds 2-3 days.

Priya Sharma: Legal: SOC2 attestation ready. KMS BYO requires KMS addendum signature; I can send the addendum and a short attestation paragraph now.

Tom Brooks: Finance: can offer a conservative draft: 0-250k $0.0045/1k, 250k-1M $0.0027/1k, 1M+ $0.0018/1k. Dedicated pool surcharge if sustained >120 RPS. I'll confirm final numbers.

Maya Patel: Action items: Priya post attestation + addendum, Diego standby for account IDs, Tom finalize pricing, I'll schedule a 20m exec call if 1+2 done by EOD.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "AuroraTech exec bridge" 20m at 2025-05-02T14:00:00Z (created by Maya Patel).

Diego Ramos: Sending peering template to customer now.

Priya Sharma: Posted attestation and addendum link.

Tom Brooks: Finance OK to proceed with draft, final numbers to follow.

Maya Patel: Thanks team — I'll update procurement when attachments are assembled. :thumbsup:
